understanding.text: The two-page HCI proposal should promptly frame the concrete problem, name at most two contributions, and connect research questions to users, evidence, methods, decisions, ethics, safety, feasibility, scope, and reproducibility. A third opening sentence may add context; headings or transitions, flow diagrams or sequence tables, fixed targets or justified ranges, and prose or tabular budgets are context-dependent alternatives. Payment method may remain undecided.
